name: Kagehira Mika
source:
Mika admires Shu Itsuki's artwork, but is now in pursuit of his own personal art form. He has a gentle personality, but there are occasionally times when the mind of a natural airhead leaks out. With his slightly melancholic singing voice, his performances are both personal and comforting.

He is a member of COSMIC PRODUCTION's Valkyrie.

[From in-game profile]
